title: Learn-Then-Differentiate Gradient Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2609.38842v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learn-then-differentiate (LTD) estimates gradients by fitting a model to simulation outputs and differentiating it. We develop a unified framework explaining what LTD differentiates and how accurately it estimates gradients. For models with a weighted representation, LTD differentiates a learned representation of the underlying probability measure. We then show how accuracy guarantees for fitted models translate into guarantees for gradients and higher-order derivatives, with rates approaching the standard Monte Carlo rate under suitable smoothness conditions. The framework recovers established results for kernel regression, local polynomial regression, and kernel ridge regression, and yields further guarantees for multiple kernel learning and smooth neural networks. These results provide a common foundation for understanding and analyzing LTD across learning methods.

translated_title: 先学习后求导的梯度估计
translated_abstract: 学习后求导通过通过对模拟输出拟合模型并对其进行求导来估计梯度。我们开发了一个统一框架，用以解释LTD究竟对什么进行求导以及它估计梯度的准确程度。对于具有加权表示的模型，LTD对底层概率测度的学习表示进行求导。随后我们展示了拟合模型的精度保证如何转化为梯度及高阶导数的精度保证，在适当的平滑性条件下，其收敛速率可接近标准蒙特卡洛速率。该框架不仅恢复了核回归、局部多项式回归和核岭回归的已有结果，还为多重核学习和平滑神经网络提供了新的保证。这些结果为理解和分析各种学习方法中的LTD提供了共同的理论基础。
tldr: 该论文建立了LTD梯度估计的统一理论框架，揭示其本质是对底层概率测度的学习表示进行求导，并证明模型拟合的精度保证可转化为梯度估计的精度保证，在适当平滑条件下收敛速率接近标准蒙特卡洛速率，为核回归、平滑神经网络等多种学习方法中的LTD分析提供了共同基础。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a unified framework for learn-then-differentiate (LTD) gradient estimation, showing that LTD differentiates a learned representation of the underlying probability measure and that accuracy guarantees for fitted models translate into gradient guarantees with rates approaching the standard Monte Carlo rate, providing a common foundation for analyzing LTD across learning methods such as kernel regression and smooth neural networks.
